prompt.text:
SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: the STORM EYE ring — a solid granite annulus (rock-grey speckled stone band, like the ridge terrain), eight dark iron compass studs set around its outer edge, a pale ice inner rim, seen flat-on; the studs march around as the ring swirls The palette: storm slate navies #10182a #1d2c46 #2f4166 #475d84, speckled granite greys and pale ice #c8d4e0 highlights, near-black navy outline — the TEMPEST RIDGE zone

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no second green shade.
- EXACTLY 4 equal square cells laid out as FOUR cells as TWO rows of TWO (2-column by 2-row) — every cell holding exactly ONE subject; a missing, empty or merged cell ruins the entire sheet.
- Cells in reading order (left-right, then top-bottom): the SAME ring, squarish (width close to height), centred in its cell at the same scale — ONLY the stud phase and swirl offset change, silhouette identical: cell 1 = studs at the compass points; cell 2 = rotated a quarter-step clockwise; cell 3 = rotated two quarter-steps; cell 4 = rotated three quarter-steps.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 512×512 px. Produce EXACTLY 4 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Each subject sits well inside its cell with at least 30 px of unbroken flat #51e018 around it and clean flat gutters between cells.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: retro 16-bit pixel art, chunky visible square pixels, flat saturated fills with a three-step shading ramp lit from the top-left, crisp 1-px near-black navy outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no soft gradients on the background, no motion blur.
prompt.negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, labels, numbers, cell borders, guide lines, grid lines, watermark, blurry, anti-aliasing, gradient background, scenery, stars, cast shadow, multiple subjects per cell, empty cell
